_comment: Pinned, SHA-256-verified sources Tommy provisions into ~/.tommy/integrated-tools at runtime. 'archives' are downloaded + hash-checked + extracted; 'scripts' are installed from the scripts/ kit shipped beside the app. Paths in 'dest' are relative to the integrated-tools root; the layout (runtimes/ mcp/ browsers/ helpers/) is preserved.

mingit._comment: MinGit (minimal PortableGit). Windows only — a hash-pinned release asset. Used to clone SearXNG at a pinned commit and to back the git_* tools. Linux has no entry; it uses system git.

libreoffice._comment: Official LibreOffice MSI, admin-extracted (msiexec /a) into helpers/libreoffice — no system install. Windows only; Linux uses system soffice on PATH. soffice runs inside the sandbox (office-document-helper on Windows, bwrap on Linux).

_searxng_comment: SearXNG is a rolling-release aggregator with no stable versioned artifact, so it's pinned to an exact commit and cloned with the bundled git (the commit SHA is the integrity pin). The overlay (patch + settings + launcher) comes from scripts/searxng/. Bump 'commit' deliberately after a smoke test.
_chromium_comment: Chromium is installed by Microsoft.Playwright (.NET) into integrated-tools/browsers; its build is pinned by the Microsoft.Playwright package version, so it has no manifest entry — the provisioner installs it directly.

pdf-render._comment: Rasterizes PDF pages to PNGs for the file pane (PyMuPDF provided by pdf-extract).

office-document-helper._comment: LM Studio's AppContainer sandbox launcher (place office-document-helper.exe in scripts/). Windows only.
